name: doctor-tracker
description: Doctor Tracker: Next.js client + Express/MongoDB REST API

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
